market.question: Will Neil Khot be the Democratic Nominee for IL-08?
market.description:
This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins the nomination for the Democratic Party to contest the IL-08 congressional district seat in the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. The Democratic primary will take place on March 17, 2026.

If no nominee is announced by November 3, 2026, 11:59PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Democrat sources, including https://democrats.org/.

Any replacement of the nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

discoveredUrls.highlight: Neil for Congress Mobilizes 200+ Voters at Trickster Cultural Center, Which Saw Highest Voter Turnout Among All Early Voting Locations - Neil Khot for Congress # Neil for Congress Mobilizes 200+ Voters at Trickster Cultural Center, Which Saw Highest Voter Turnout Among All Early Voting Locations - March 3, 2026 After the first day of early voting in the 8th district yesterday, Congressional candidate Neil Khot has the following statement: “Yesterday was the first day of early voting in the 8th district. My campaign and I mobilized over 200 voters to turn out at the Trickster Cultural Center in Schaumburg. By the end of the day, more than 320 voters had voted there—the highest number of any other early voting location yesterday. This tells me that our campaign continues to have strong momentum.” “While Melissa Bean has received more than $4 million from AIPAC and Republican dark money groups, I am running an honest campaign and refuse to take these kind of donations. At the same time, voters across the 8th District are recognizing that I bring new leadership, job creation experience, and a strong track record of protecting our communities. I have the experience needed to grow our local economy and position our district as the manufacturing capital of America.” Neil Khot and his supporters after voting at Trickster Cultural Center.
